propositions: Central immutable OperationSnapshot must capture validated non-secret configuration state with explicit provenance source-kind and repository root, serializable and fingerprinted without secrets, live auth, or capability objects.

Composition precedence is explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default; repository root selected independently from repo_root > REBAR_ROOT > Git top-level/current directory.

Shadow mode (enabled by default via REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW) composes and validates snapshots without altering execution; malformed selected config fails fast before lock/network/write, other shadow failures emit redacted warnings and fall through to legacy behavior.

CLI, Python library, MCP, and direct reconciler entry points each compose one snapshot at the approved boundary using the same central composer, threading it through representative ticket/store, LLM-gate, and reconcile operations.
Snapshot mutation after capture does not affect the captured operation's serialized state; a second operation observes new environment/file/cwd values.
Setting REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW to canonical false disables shadow construction and restores legacy entry-point behavior without changing stored ticket/bridge formats.
